page.overview:
What is Bakura Incident?

The Bakura Incident, also known as the Bakura Campaign, was the name given to the series of battles in the Bakura system, that began the day after the Battle of Endor, in 4 ABY and would last a single week. The campaign consisted of the Invasion of Bakura, the Bakura Truce, and the Battle of Bakura.
